# Card Concrete Construction

Concrete and demolition contractor based in Sparta, Tennessee.
Service radius: 50 miles from Sparta, TN (Upper Cumberland region).

## Contact
- Phone: (931) 261-9710
- Email: cardconcreteconstruction@yahoo.com
- Address: 575 Pin Hook Rd, Sparta, TN 38583
- Hours: Mon–Fri 7:00a–5:00p, Sat by appointment

## Services
- Laser screed (commercial floors, FF/FL spec)
- Commercial slabs
- Flat work (driveways, sidewalks, patios)
- Stamped concrete
- Interior demolition
- Wall demolition
- Total structure demolition

## Service area
Sparta, Cookeville, McMinnville, Crossville, Smithville, Monterey, Livingston, Spencer, Algood — and surrounding Upper Cumberland communities within a 50-mile radius.
